messages:
maria-cs: Alert: onboarding delays for ~15 tenants provisioned during last night's EU index migration. Need customer comms, translations, and a credit offer.

ashley-se: Pls DM tenant list + 1-line RCA we can paste to customers. ETA to restore?

maria-cs: DM sent. RCA: indexer backlog + aggressive provisioning retries triggered an internal rate limiter during migration traffic.

sam-eng: Mitigation applied: added indexer capacity, relaxed retry backoff, temporarily widened limiter window. Queue depth dropping; expect catch-up ~30-45m.

neil-ops: Limiter config rolled at 17:18 UTC; backfill in progress (9/15 done). Monitoring.

lina-localization: I can return FR/DE/ES translations in ~20m once final copy posted.

incident-bot: INC-2026-042 created: "EU migration onboarding latency" Severity=S2 Owners=sam-eng,neil-ops,maria-cs

maria-cs: Draft outbound (customer-facing): short apology, what we did, offer 1 week credits (2 for high-touch), optional 1:1 office hours, reply to prioritize import. Will send high-touch individualized notes in 45m and bulk localized note to trials after translations. Post RCA in ~24h.
